title: A novel product shape innovation design method based on Kansei Engineering and GAN model with limited sample data
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The paper proposes a method combining Kansei Engineering and GANs for product design, using limited sample data. It involves collecting and processing product images, analyzing Kansei words, and training a generative model to create new design concepts. The method is validated through perceptual imagery vocabulary scoring and entropy weight method evaluation.

chains.reliability_evidence: To ensure the reliability of the dataset, the following multi-stage filtering process was performed: (1) Duplication: Images with the same URL, file name, or close visual content (verified by the Structural Similarity Index SSIM) were removed. (2) Viewpoint Control: Only images showing side or three-quarter perspective views of the product were retained to maintain consistency in the contour and shape analysis. (3) Clarity and Integrity: Exclude images with low resolution, obscured or missing product components. (4) Background nor- malisation: exclude excessive watermarks or complex background images, so as not to affect the contour extraction.
